VL1.description: Recreate the structure exactly as shown in the image.

L2.description: Build a 2D pyramid consisting of two layers: the first layer has two blocks, and the second layer has one block placed on top.

VL2.description: Rearrange all the blocks in the image into a vertical 2D line, then reduce the length of the resulting structure by one block in any direction.

L3.description: Build an R-shaped structure that is five blocks tall.

VL3.description: Build only structures containing at least one green block, as shown in the image.

L4.description: Construct the number '3' using a segmented digit font style. Use only orange and green blocks if possible; if those colors are unavailable, substitute with other colors.

VL4.description: Recreate the exact structure shown in the image, replacing the bottom two blocks with yellow ones; if yellow is unavailable, use other colors.

L5.description: Construct a spiral structure using 10 blocks arranged counterclockwise, moving inward.

VL5.description: Construct only the bottom-left three-block corner of the structure shown in the image. Set aside the remaining blocks and arrange them in a zigzag pattern.

L6.description: Construct a Q-shaped structure that is four blocks tall. Next, remove the junction where the loop meets the tail. If possible, use the removed blocks to create a three-dimensional vertical stack.

VL6.description: Construct only the 3x3 square layers of the structure shown in the image. Set the remaining blocks aside and stack them vertically.

L7.description: Construct a 3D pyramid composed of two layers, with the base layer measuring 3 blocks by 3 blocks. Each higher layer should maintain a similar overall shape, reducing the length of each side by one block compared to the layer below. Use green blocks wherever possible; if green blocks are unavailable, substitute blocks of other colors.

VL7.description: Recreate the structure exactly as shown in the image, but replace the right six-block slanted legs with red blocks; if red is unavailable, use other colors.

L8.description: Construct the numeral '5 using a segmented digit font. Assign the following colors to the segments: color the top horizontal segment green, the vertical segment red, and the bottom horizontal segment blue. If there are any conflicts in color assignments, prioritize the color specified earlier in the instructions. For any remaining unassigned segments, use yellow if possible; if yellow cannot be used, select the color that most closely resembles yellow.

VL8.description: Rearrange all blocks in the image into a 2D pyramid, then rotate the entire structure 180° clockwise using pick-and-place only.

L9.description: Construct a 2D pyramid consisting of four layers, with each layer containing, from bottom to top, 4 blocks, 3 blocks, 2 blocks, and 1 block, respectively. Color every alternate layer, starting from the top left diagonal edge, yellow. Distribute the remaining colors—blue, green, red, and orange—as evenly as possible among the other blocks; if an even distribution is not possible, approximate it as closely as you can. Then, construct an identical 2D pyramid directly behind the first one, using blue blocks if available; if not, use other available colors.

VL9.description: Rebuild the structure exactly as shown, replacing the green blocks with blue ones if possible; otherwise, use different colors. Then, shift the entire structure 4 blocks to the left. If a collision occurs, stack the blocks atop the obstacle.

L10.description: Construct a 3D pyramid consisting of four layers, with the base layer forming a 4x4 square. Each successive layer should maintain the same overall pyramid shape but decrease by one block on each side. Use yellow blocks exclusively if available; if not, substitute with blocks of other colors. Once the pyramid is complete, separate and remove every alternate layer, beginning with the bottom layer. Allow any unsupported blocks from the remaining structure to fall downward until they rest on a solid surface. Finally, rotate the resulting assembly 45 degrees clockwise using only pick-and-place movements.

VL10.description: Recreate the structure exactly as shown. Then, add one block atop each vertical stack containing at least one orange block, using a color different from the block below. Next, remove the 10 red supporting blocks that have any blocks above them, allowing unsupported blocks to fall and find support. Finally, rotate the entire remaining structure 180° counterclockwise using only pick and place.
